hyperedges.description: Canonical detail artifacts plus governed summaries and manifests.
Governed state composition combines identity, calendar, price, microstructure, fundamentals, and news under one decision-time cutoff and separate labels.
Minute-data consumers select raw, quote-guarded, or split-normalized views according to local truth, quality repair, or cross-session comparability.
Candidate selection and event windows may construct decision-safe state, but post-event outcomes remain a separate non-feature layer.
Dataset use requires aligned contract, registry, and consumer boundary authority.
Daily and intraday datasets retain explicit, non-interchangeable price-view semantics.
Context consumers must preserve as-of timing, lag, and source scope.
Event states, temporal windows, and future outcomes remain distinct governed artifacts.
Identity and session authorities anchor master daily and intraday tables.
Context outputs require explicit as-of, availability, source, and lag semantics.
Adjusted daily promotion links semantics, acceptance gates, plans, landing, manifest, and validated pilot evidence.
Audit status, consumer class, contract family, and consumer contract jointly determine lawful use.
The restricted bridge preserves exact PIT universe membership for the daily-label consumer.
Label promotion preserves adjusted-price semantics, operational lineage, and separation from features.
Physical evidence, human inspection, readiness gates, and evidence levels determine layer maturity.
The bounded regime-feature family links taxonomy, constraints, deferrals, evidence, promotion, and landing.
Layer architecture, maturity gates, module scope, and protected boundaries jointly govern foundation change.
Migration preserves authority through pre-audit, explicit mapping, risk batching, and stable naming.
The split-normalized candidate links price semantics, plans, controls, landing, manifests, and bounded evidence.
Three compared families plus explicit deferred Trades semantics.
Probe PASS does not open Full before Trades completion and human authorization.
Nine validators jointly enforce the governed audit contract.
